title: Fortaleza and Náutico Face Off in 31st Round of Série B
subtitle: Understanding the Importance of the Match for Promotion and the Situation of Both Clubs
excerpt: Fortaleza hosts Náutico on Friday, October 2, at 21:35, in a match that could bring Tricolor closer to leadership and change the position of the Pernambuco team
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The confrontation between Fortaleza and Náutico, valid for the 31st round of Série B, gained prominence because it can change the position of both clubs in the table. Tricolor, which occupies third place with 52 points, needs to win to reach 55 and pressure the leadership, while Náutico, in 14th with 41 points, seeks to move away from the risk zone.

What's at Stake for Fortaleza

With four wins and six draws in the last ten games, Fortaleza remains unbeaten under the command of Paulo Autuori. The team is in third place and has not lost in the second half. A triumph over Náutico could put them at 55 points, a condition necessary to take the lead if the current leader, Vila Nova, is defeated.

What Náutico Needs

Náutico, led by Bruno Pivetti, also hasn't lost in this campaign, although they've only accumulated one point in the last confrontations. The team is in 14th place and needs positive results to escape the relegation zone. One point against Fortaleza may be enough to maintain the distance from the last-placed teams.

How to Watch the Match

The game will be broadcast live by ESPN, a closed channel, and by the Disney+ streaming service. The match is scheduled for 21:35, at Castelão, and will be followed by fans from all over the country.

Náutico's Individual Performance

In the previous match, Vinícius was Náutico's highlight by scoring the equalizing goal. Vinícius himself received a 5.5 rating from GE. Arnaldo, who gave the assist for the goal, got a 6.0 rating, while Léo Índio was rated 5.5 for his defensive performance and play construction. Samuel and Luiz Felipe had ratings of 5.0 and 4.5, respectively, indicating difficulties in the midfield and physical aspect. In the offensive sector, Júnior Todinho received a 4.5 rating, being considered the least productive, while Derek and Borasi were rated 5.5 and 5.0, contributing more in marking than in attack.

Expectations for the Match

Fortaleza takes to the field seeking to turn their draws into victories and consolidate their position as a candidate for promotion. Meanwhile, Náutico seeks to improve their collective performance, taking advantage of the evolution shown in the last games under Pivetti's direction. The duel promises to be disputed, with both coaches seeking tactical adjustments to maximize scoring opportunities.

With information from ge, Estadão, O POVO.
